The Pre-Sales Solutions Architect (SA) Leader owns the health, direction, and performance of the Solutions Architecture function. Where an individual SA is the technical owner within the sales cycle for their assigned opportunities, the SA Leader is accountable for technical win rate and deal velocity across the entire pre-sales motion — every channel the team supports, and the people who deliver against it.
The SA Leader is a player-coach: they carry direct accountability for channel coverage, the most strategic or highest-stakes evaluations, and cross-functional GTM alignment, while spending the majority of their time developing individual SAs so the team's proactive, commercially-sharp approach scales without becoming order-taking.
Compensation Note: SA Leader compensation is tied to team-wide ARR bookings — new logo, expansion, and multi-year commitments across every SA's pipeline, not just deals the Leader personally works. The Leader is expected to operate with the same commercial mindset as the team, at portfolio scale.

People Leadership & Team Development
The SA Leader hires, coaches, and grows the SA team so each member operates as a credible, commercially sharp technical partner in the sales cycle. This includes:
Hiring and onboarding new SAs, including calibrating them against the channel-specific technical evaluation prompts
Running regular 1:1s, reviewing deal strategy, PoC scoping, and objection handling, and giving direct feedback
Building and maintaining repeatable playbooks (discovery frameworks, PoC templates, objection/RFP responses, competitive positioning) so quality doesn't depend on tenure
Setting and holding the team to a consistent bar for technical depth, commercial instinct, and quota attainment
Channel & Coverage Ownership
The SA Leader owns the coverage model for the entire function — deciding, tracking, and rebalancing which SAs support which channels, and closing gaps as pipeline shifts. This includes accountability across all five channels in the SA Channel Mapping :
Direct Sales (AMER, EMEA, APJ)
Hyperscalers (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI)
Accelerators, Incubators, VCs (YCombinator, TechStars, 500 Startups)
SfP + OAuth Partners (Lovable, Bolt, Anthropic)
Solution Providers ( Postgres.ai , Stormatics)
Rebalancing SA assignment across channels as pipeline volume, deal complexity, or new partner motions shift
Resolving coverage gaps (a channel with no dedicated SA depth, or a region outgrowing its current allocation) and deciding when a hire, a cross-channel reassignment, or a controlled exception is the right fix
Approving which opportunities warrant Leader-level involvement directly, versus staying with the assigned SA
Technical Sales Ownership (oversight)
The SA Leader ensures every significant opportunity has a clear, accountable technical owner across architecture fit, use cases, evaluation criteria, and competitive positioning — spot-checking deal documentation and risk tracking across the pipeline, and stepping in directly on the largest or most strategic evaluations.

The SA Leader ensures the team consistently qualifies opportunities as technically winnable early, coaching SAs on discovery quality and holding the team accountable for surfacing deal-level risk to AEs and sales leadership before it costs a deal.
Proof of Concept and Evaluation Support (oversight)
The SA Leader ensures PoCs across the team are scoped to demonstrate differentiated value, not just technical box-checking — auditing success criteria, evaluation structure, and win-rate patterns across the whole book of active evaluations.
Technical Objection Handling (oversight)
The SA Leader is the escalation layer above the individual SA for the hardest architecture, security, or compliance objections — brought in on RFPs, security questionnaires, and competitive deals that could stall without senior technical input, without replacing the SA as the deal's primary technical contact.
Commercial Technical Alignment (oversight)
The SA Leader ensures the team consistently connects technical requirements to commercial outcomes across the pipeline, and personally engages on pricing/packaging justification and expansion-signal strategy for the largest deals.
Internal Collaboration
Sales (Account Executives)
The SA Leader partners with Sales leadership to make sure SA/AE pairing is working at the portfolio level — owning the technical narrative in aggregate while sales leadership owns the commercial motion — and personally steps in when a specific SA/AE partnership needs adjudicating.
Partnerships
The SA Leader works with Partner Leads across every channel (Hyperscalers, Accelerators, SfP+OAuth, Solution Providers) to make sure SA support scales with each channel's motion, while commercial terms and channel strategy stay owned by the Partner Lead.
Engineering and Product
The SA Leader represents the aggregated market signal — patterns across deals, not just one opportunity — to engineering and product, and prioritizes which recurring technical blockers or roadmap gaps are costing the team deals versus which are one-offs.
Technical Account Management (TAM) and Customer Engineering
The SA Leader ensures handoff quality from pre-sale to post-sale is consistent across the team — auditing that architecture decisions, commitments, and open items are documented well enough that TAMs and CEs can drive early adoption without re-discovering the deal.
Success Metrics
SA Leader effectiveness is measured by commercial and technical outcomes across the whole team, not just their own deals:
Team ARR Bookings — new logo and expansion ARR across every SA's pipeline, relative to team quota
Deal Velocity — time from technical qualification to technical win, tracked across channels
PoC Win Rate — percentage of structured evaluations that convert to closed-won, team-wide
Pipeline Coverage — volume and quality of SA-engaged opportunities relative to quota, per channel
Handoff Quality — post-sale team satisfaction with documentation and deal context, across the team
Team health — ramp time to productivity for new SAs, retention of the SA team itself

About Zelara
Most CRM marketing still blasts generic messages at scale and calls it "personalization." Our founders experienced this firsthand in senior roles at HelloFresh, Salesforce, Uber, and others. Backed by top-tier VCs, they decided to build a better way.
Zelara is an agentic lifecycle marketing platform that improves with every interaction. It works with the CRM infrastructure our customers already use, replacing static journeys and manual segmentation with a system that creates content, makes individual-level decisions, and learns from every outcome.
With bunq, Europe's second-largest neobank, we delivered +7.4% activation and +66% reactivation uplift , measured against a control group. We raised a €3M pre-seed and are generating revenue with paying enterprise customers. Now we are hiring our first Solutions Architect to make the path from integration to measurable value repeatable.

This is a deeply technical customer role centered on post-sales value realization, with involvement in pre-sales discovery. It is not conventional customer success built around reactive support and business reviews, nor a pre-sales role that hands off at signature.
You will own technical value realization for a portfolio of customers, from discovery and onboarding through live experiments, measured results, and scaled adoption.
You and the commercial lead run each account as a pair, in a weekly rhythm and in the room together for the conversations that decide something. They own pricing, proposals, contracts, conversion to an annual contract, expansion, and renewal. You own the technical plan and evidence behind those decisions.

Before signature, you lead technical discovery alongside them. After signature, you become the customer's named technical lead, accountable for solution design, data mapping, the experiment plan, stakeholder coordination, and go-live. You make value real and defensible; the commercial lead owns the close.
There is no separate customer success manager, and we are not planning one. The two of you hold the whole relationship: the commercial lead is the account owner, you are the technical owner, and the working relationship with the customer's CRM, data, and analytics teams is yours.
Your focus is the customer-specific application of Zelara's platform. Product owns the roadmap and prioritization. Engineering owns production software, reusable integrations, reliability, and security. Science owns the learning methods and models, experimental methodology, and causal measurement standards. You turn their work into a functioning customer solution and bring in each team when a requirement crosses those boundaries.
Today our founders lead the technical side of every customer relationship. You will take over that responsibility and build the function as the customer base grows.
You will work with mid-market and enterprise B2C companies across Europe: fintech, e-commerce, travel, and employee benefits. Successful pilots grow into long-term, scaled deployments.

Own the technical customer journey from discovery through onboarding, pilot delivery, measured value, and scaled adoption
Lead technical discovery before signature: understand how the customer makes money and which metric moves it, then validate the integration path, available data, measurement feasibility, and what the pilot can credibly promise
Own onboarding: align stakeholders, define the data mapping and acceptance criteria, coordinate implementation, and take the customer live on its existing CRM stack
Design and pre-register each customer experiment using Zelara's scientific standards: hypothesis, primary metric, cohort, control group, conversion window, success threshold, and decision rules, because a success bar set after seeing the data is not a result
Own the customer-facing interpretation of results: reconcile Zelara's analysis with the customer's data, involve Science in novel or ambiguous analyses, and state clearly when the evidence is not decision-ready
Enable the customer's team to operate campaigns independently rather than becoming the person who runs them
Partner with the commercial lead on annual contracts, expansion, and renewal: identify the opportunity, quantify the value, and de-risk the technical plan
Drive the product loop rather than report into it: turn recurring customer needs into product opportunities, engineering requirements, and research questions, and bring the evidence from live accounts that decides their priority
Build what closes the gap in the meantime: use agents to produce the scripts, tooling, and prototypes that unblock an account before the platform covers it
Your First 90 Days
30 Days (Immersion): Learn the platform and customer portfolio, join every active account, and take ownership of your first technical customer relationship.
60 Days (Ownership): Lead one onboarding independently, with the integration requirements, campaign configuration, experiment design, and measurement plan agreed before launch.
90 Days (Scale): Own a small portfolio, deliver your first evidence-backed results readout, use it with the commercial lead to inform an annual-contract or expansion decision, and improve the playbook based on live accounts.

You have led deployments, implementations, or technical accounts for mid-market or enterprise customers at a B2B SaaS company, and your work has influenced adoption, renewal, or expansion.
You judge a customer's business before you design for it: which metric their leadership is measured on, which one is decoration, and what matters that nobody has said out loud. You aim the solution at the first.
You can turn a business question into an analysis plan: define the right metric, cohort, and measurement window; identify what would disprove the claim; and judge whether the evidence is decision-ready.

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Claude Code is changing how engineering organizations build software, and most of them need someone to show them how. That's you.
Technical Architects help customers get real work done with Claude Code, Claude Tag (Claude Code as an agent in Slack), and the enterprise admin controls that decide whether a rollout succeeds. You'll teach customers, partners and Anthropic's own field teams. Just as important, you'll train the trainers who carry that knowledge to everyone else.
We're hands-on AI engineers who would rather teach than sell. You'll work alongside customer engineering organizations, teaching them about Claude Code and shepherding rollouts with advanced admin knowledge. Most weeks you're in front of an audience with Claude Desktop or a terminal open: thousands of engineers on a public webinar one day, a customer's platform team in their own conference room the next week, office hours in between. The prep material often reaches you the day before.
The team is growing quickly this year, scope will grow as new products ship, and the people who join now will shape how it works.

Teach in every format. Take a standing rotation on Anthropic's public webinars in front of thousands of engineers at a time. Lead workshops and multi-day onsites, in person and virtual, built around a customer's own codebase and questions. Host office hours and multi-week cohorts where engineers, partners, and account teams bring live problems.
Teach the teachers. Run train-the-trainer programs for customer technologists and champions, and certify them to deliver Anthropic's material.
Empower admins. Educate enterprise admins on the technical requirements for a strong rollout by guiding them through single sign-on, permissions, connectors, spend controls, data-handling policy, and other advanced topics.
Build fast with Claude. Turn a request into a polished deck, demo repository or plugin within a day, using the tools you teach. Explore new features the day they ship. Pick up a teammate's material and deliver it as if you wrote it.
Bring field signal back to product. Tell the Claude Code, Claude Tag and Cowork teams what customers run into, specifically enough that they can fix it.
Be the technical voice in the room. Partner with account executives, customer success managers, Applied AI Architects, support engineers and partner leads.
Travel. Expect 30 to 50%, in bursts around onsites, workshops and events.
You may be a good fit if you have
5+ years as a software engineer, solutions architect, developer advocate or similar. You still ship code and regularly teach engineering audiences.
Current engineering range. You've shipped code other people depend on. You can go deep with a senior engineer anywhere in the stack. You use Claude Code or a similar agentic tool every day and have opinions about it.
Big-stage presence. You've held large live audiences. You sound practiced with material you got that morning, and a broken demo doesn’t faze you.
Range in one conversation. You can go from banter to a rigorous design discussion, and both feel natural.
Care for people. You do right by a struggling customer, and you won't leave a confused room behind.
Initiative. You build things without waiting for permission, and you say when an idea is half-formed, including your manager's.
Steadiness when priorities shift, timelines are short and colleagues are under pressure.
Comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving industry and product suite.
A stake in safe AI. You care that large organizations deploy AI responsibly, and you want to help them do it.
You love being on the frontier. You want to work at the edge of what’s possible and help define what comes next.

Depth in enterprise identity and security review (SAML, OIDC, SCIM, SOC 2, HIPAA).
Experience running Claude on Amazon Bedrock or Google Cloud Vertex AI.
Time with regulated industries or with systems-integrator partners.
A public record of technical teaching: talks, courses, videos or writing.
An interest outside technology you can talk about with the same energy.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. # Lead / Principal AI Infrastructure Architect
## Über die Position
Wir suchen einen **Lead / Principal AI Infrastructure Architect**, der die durchgängige Verantwortung für den Entwurf, die Bereitstellung und die Optimierung der Infrastruktur für groß angelegte Workloads im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) und maschinelles Lernen (ML) übernimmt.
Der Schwerpunkt der Rolle liegt auf der Architektur hochskalierbarer und kosteneffizienter Rechenumgebungen, einschließlich **GPU-Clustern, Plattformen für verteiltes Training, Infrastruktur für Model-Serving, Netzwerktechnik, Speicherlösungen, Orchestrierung sowie cloudbasierten KI/ML-Plattformen**.
Sie übersetzen Geschäftsziele, Service-Level-Anforderungen, Sicherheitsstandards und technische Rahmenbedingungen in robuste Infrastrukturarchitekturen. Sie evaluieren alternative Lösungen, treffen fundierte Architekturentscheidungen und stellen sicher, dass die Plattformen auf **Leistung, Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit, Sicherheit und Kosteneffizienz** ausgelegt sind.
Als technische Führungskraft übernehmen Sie die architektonische Leitung, etablieren Engineering-Standards und Best Practices, betreuen (mentoren) Ingenieure und Architekten und arbeiten eng mit Kunden und Stakeholdern zusammen, um Infrastrukturstrategien und Roadmaps zu definieren.
## Kernaufgaben
### KI/ML-Infrastrukturarchitektur
* Übernahme der Gesamtverantwortung für Architektur und Design der Infrastruktur für groß angelegte KI/ML-Systeme – vom ersten Konzept bis zur Implementierung und Bereitstellung.
* Entwurf der Infrastruktur für verteiltes KI/ML-Training, Inferenz und Model-Serving-Workloads.
* Architektur und Optimierung des gesamten Rechen-Stacks, einschließlich **Rechenleistung, GPUs/Beschleunigern, Netzwerktechnik, Speicher, Orchestrierung und Model-Serving**.
* Evaluierung von Architekturalternativen und Treffen fundierter Entscheidungen auf der Basis von Leistung, Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit, Kosten, Sicherheit und Kundenanforderungen.
* Sicherstellung, dass die Infrastrukturarchitekturen mit vereinbarten geschäftlichen SLAs, technischen Standards und betrieblichen Anforderungen im Einklang stehen.
### GPU- und Distributed Computing
* Entwurf und Optimierung groß angelegter **GPU- und beschleunigerbasierter Cluster** für KI/ML-Workloads.
* Evaluierung und Auswahl geeigneter GPU-/Beschleunigertechnologien basierend auf den Anforderungen der Workloads.
* Entwurf von Hochleistungsnetzwerken und Interconnect-Architekturen für verteiltes Training.
* Architektur von Speicherlösungen, die KI/ML-Workloads mit hohem Durchsatz unterstützen.
* Identifizierung und Behebung von Infrastruktur-Engpässen, die sich auf Training, Inferenz, Durchsatz oder Skalierbarkeit auswirken. * Optimierung der Infrastruktur hinsichtlich Leistung, Energieverbrauch, Auslastung und Kosten.
### Cloud-KI/ML-Architektur
* Fungieren als technischer Experte für mindestens eine der großen Hyperscaler-Plattformen, wie z. B. **AWS, Microsoft Azure oder Google Cloud**.
* Anwendung fundierter Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Cloud-KI/ML-Dienste, Rechenplattformen, Beschleuniger (Accelerators), Netzwerk, Speicher, Orchestrierung und Preismodelle.
* Bewertung von Cloud-Architekturoptionen und Empfehlung von Lösungen, die den Anforderungen an Workload, Sicherheit, Leistung und Kosten entsprechen.
* Entwurf skalierbarer Cloud- und Hybrid-Infrastrukturen für KI/ML-Workloads auf Unternehmens- und Großskalenebene.
* Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten zur Optimierung der Cloud-Auslastung und der Infrastrukturkosten.
### Architekturbewertung und Governance
* Leitung von Bewertungen und Überprüfungen bestehender und geplanter KI/ML-Infrastrukturumgebungen.
* Identifizierung von Architekturlücken, technischen Risiken, Leistungsengpässen, Skalierbarkeitsproblemen und Optimierungspotenzialen.
* Festlegung von Strategien zur Problembehebung und Erarbeitung technischer Empfehlungen.
* Etablierung von Architekturstandards, Mustern (Patterns) und Best Practices für die KI-Infrastruktur.
* Dokumentation von Architekturentscheidungen, Annahmen, Abwägungen (Trade-offs) und technischen Begründungen.
* Sicherstellung der Einhaltung relevanter Sicherheits-, Regulierungs-, Governance- und Kundenstandards.
### Infrastruktur-Roadmap und Kapazitätsplanung
* Definition und Pflege der Technologie-Roadmap für die KI/ML-Infrastruktur.
* Entwicklung von Kapazitätsplänen unter Berücksichtigung der Anforderungen von Geschäftsbereichen, Produkten und KI/ML-Workloads.
* Prognose des Bedarfs an Rechenleistung, Speicher, Netzwerkkapazität und Beschleunigern.
* Entwicklung von Kostenmodellen für die Infrastruktur und Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten zur Kostenoptimierung.
* Planung der technologischen Weiterentwicklung, des Workload-Wachstums und der Plattform-Skalierbarkeit.
### Automatisierung, Bereitstellung und Betrieb
* Entwurf von Bereitstellungs- und Automatisierungsstrategien für eine zuverlässige, reproduzierbare und skalierbare KI/ML-Infrastruktur.
* Etablierung geeigneter **CI/CD- und Infrastructure-as-Code-Ansätze** für KI/ML-Plattformen und -Workloads.
* Unterstützung der automatisierten Bereitstellung von KI-Systemen, Modellen und Datenpipelines in Produktionsumgebungen.
* Definition von Betriebsprozessen zur Gewährleistung von Zuverlässigkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Reproduzierbarkeit.
* Etablierung von Strategien für Monitoring und Observability über Infrastruktur- und MLOps-Umgebungen hinweg.

GTM Architects are permanently embedded in the GTM organization, each owning a portion of a customer and prospect lifecycle that spans Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support; when they address friction in one stage, they work the surrounding levers holistically, mapping how those functions connect today and how AI could connect them better.

G&A Architects rotate across corporate functions like Finance, People, Legal, and Operations, driving each cohort to self-sufficiency.

You inherit the hiring manager seat for all Architect roles, a unified interview loop, and an operating model with real momentum. De beste software begint niet met code, maar met de juiste keuzes. En steeds vaker begint dat met de vraag: hoe kunnen we technologie en AI slim inzetten om meer waarde te creëren?
Als Solution Architect bij adesso help jij organisaties hun digitale uitdagingen te vertalen naar slimme, toekomstbestendige softwareoplossingen. Je begrijpt de business en de vraag achter de vraag, ontwikkelt een heldere oplossingsrichting en weet klanten én developmentteams daarin mee te nemen.
Je bent vanaf het eerste gesprek betrokken en kijkt verder dan alleen de technische oplossing. Je herkent kansen bij onze klanten, denkt commercieel mee en helpt vanuit jouw expertise om nieuwe opdrachten en langdurige klantrelaties te ontwikkelen. Zodra een opdracht start, blijf je verantwoordelijk voor de inhoudelijke en technische koers. Je ontwerpt dus niet alleen de oplossing, maar zorgt er samen met het team voor dat deze succesvol wordt gerealiseerd.
AI is daarbij een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van hoe we bij adesso werken. Je onderzoekt actief waar AI waarde kan toevoegen voor onze klanten én gebruikt AI om je eigen werk slimmer en effectiever te maken. Niet omdat AI altijd het antwoord is, maar omdat je weet wat er mogelijk is en bewust de juiste technologie kiest.
En hoewel je veel met en voor klanten werkt, bouw je altijd vanuit adesso. Je deelt kennis en ervaringen met collega's, draagt bij aan onze proposities en brengt kansen en inzichten uit de markt terug naar de organisatie. Zo bouwen we samen aan onze klanten, onze expertise en de groei van adesso.
Wat ga je doen?

s.h: Geen dag is hetzelfde, maar je houdt je onder andere bezig met
s.t:
Het begeleiden van klanten bij complexe digitaliseringsvraagstukken en het vertalen daarvan naar concrete oplossingen en kansen.
Het analyseren van de vraag achter de vraag en het begeleiden van discovery workshops.
Het ontwerpen en presenteren van solution architecturen waarin software, cloud, data en AI samenkomen.
Het actief onderzoeken waar AI waarde kan toevoegen binnen klantprocessen, producten en oplossingen.
Het ontwikkelen en verder brengen van innovatieve proposities rondom software, cloud en AI binnen adesso.
Het herkennen van commerciële kansen bij bestaande en nieuwe klanten en deze samen met collega's verder ontwikkelen.
Het ondersteunen van sales tijdens klantgesprekken, offertes, pitches en aanbestedingen.
Het overtuigen van klanten met een inhoudelijk sterk voorstel én een duidelijke businesswaarde.
Het nemen van de technische lead zodra een project start.
Het begeleiden van developmentteams en bewaken van de gekozen architectuur.
Het signaleren van nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en deze vertalen naar concrete klantwaarde.
Het actief delen van kennis, klantinzichten en best practices binnen adesso.
Wanneer ben jij succesvol?
Jij bent succesvol wanneer klanten jou zien als een trusted advisor : iemand die hun business begrijpt, technologisch vooruitkijkt en kansen ziet om samen meer waarde te creëren.
Je zorgt ervoor dat projecten technisch de juiste koers volgen en developmentteams vanuit een heldere architectuur kunnen bouwen. Tegelijkertijd kijk je verder dan de opdracht van vandaag. Je ziet waar we een klant verder kunnen helpen, brengt nieuwe ideeën in en betrekt de juiste collega's en expertise vanuit adesso.
Je bent nieuwsgierig naar wat AI en nieuwe technologie mogelijk maken en maakt dit onderdeel van je dagelijkse manier van werken. Je bent net zo overtuigend in een boardroom als aan een whiteboard met developers en schakelt moeiteloos tussen business, commercie en techniek.
Want als Solution Architect bij adesso bouw je niet alleen aan een oplossing voor de klant. Je bouwt mee aan de klantrelatie, aan onze expertise én aan adesso.
Wie ben jij?
Je bent een ervaren softwareprofessional die verder kijkt dan technologie alleen.
Je begrijpt hoe organisaties werken, welke afwegingen opdrachtgevers moeten maken en hoe je technische mogelijkheden vertaalt naar bedrijfswaarde.

Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring binnen softwareontwikkeling.
Ervaring als Solution Architect, Software Architect, Lead Developer of Principal Engineer.
Ervaring met Java en/of Kotlin.
Kennis van cloudplatformen zoals Azure, AWS of Google Cloud.
Ervaring met moderne softwarearchitecturen, microservices, API's en event-driven oplossingen.
Ervaring met enterprise softwareontwikkeling.
Interesse in AI en GenAI en de praktische toepassing daarvan.
Ervaring met klantadvies, workshops of presales is een pre.
Waarom deze rol?
Omdat je hier meer doet dan architecturen ontwerpen.
Je helpt organisaties richting te geven aan hun digitale transformatie, ontwikkelt nieuwe proposities, wint samen met collega's nieuwe opdrachten en ziet vervolgens hoe jouw oplossing werkelijkheid wordt.
Je krijgt de ruimte om invloed uit te oefenen op technologie, innovatie én de groei van onze organisatie

Hatch engineering culture is driven by speed, ownership, and impact. We're a small, ambitious team building AI that transforms how service businesses grow, and we move fast. Engineers own problems end to end, ship to production early, and work across a modern stack on problems that directly shape the customer experience. At the end of the day, we're here to build something that matters, grow as engineers, and do it together.
The Solutions Architect helps Hatch win complex deals by mapping customer systems, scoping the technical path to onboarding, and owning implementation through go-live.
This is a hands-on role. You're in discovery calls, leading technical demos, writing the scope document onboarding runs from, and personally leading implementation for complex accounts. Managers should expect this person to be active in deals and deployments.
This opportunity is hybrid based out of our San Francisco office
We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Hatch, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes.

Co-own discovery calls with the AE - surface integration requirements early, before they become deal risk. Own the discovery motion for integrations: CRM/system of record, lead source & attribution, scheduling workflows, call center systems, data syncs, webhooks, API access, automation requirements, reporting needs, edge cases. Lead technically complex demos involving third party integrations.
Scope CRM, lead source, API capabilities and constraints, and overall integration complexity for every late-stage deal. You must be comfortable evaluating APIs, reviewing technical documentation, and determining integration feasibility and effort. Deliver a written complexity tier after qualification and produce the Technical Scope document at close, which serves as the blueprint for onboarding. Advise the AE on technical risk, feasibility, and pricing implications before proposals go out.
Hand off the Technical Scope to onboarding with a live walkthrough - no critical gaps discovered post-handoff. Work with the Forward Deployed Engineer and Account Manager to ensure technically complex accounts are onboarded successfully (~4–8 weeks); you're the primary technical owner through go-live.
Participate in a post-launch technical health check on every account you led. Work with post-sales team to maintain a QA checklist covering data sync accuracy, integration error monitoring, and scope drift identification
Stay current on product updates, new integrations, and capability changes. No deal should be lost because your knowledge was stale. Build and own the integration discovery question set - keep it current, make it usable by the broader sales team
What it takes to succeed
Question assumptions. If something's been done a certain way because it always has been, test it. Stack-rank your initiatives - weigh upside against effort, share the reasoning
Work with Operations to make sure critical metrics (integration error rates, onboarding cycle time, scope accuracy) are monitored. If you can't measure it, escalate it. Know enough SQL to pull your own data on deal complexity, onboarding performance, and integration health
Feed learnings back to Product and Engineering - you're closer to the customer's real environment than almost anyone
Flag technical risk in deals before the AE asks - don't wait. When a scoping decision involves a tradeoff between deal velocity and technical risk, surface it explicitly - don't make that call unilaterally
Communicate tradeoffs clearly to all audiences: Sales (deal risk), customers (realistic expectations), Product and Engineering (patterns and constraints). Send status updates at key milestones - thorough on drivers, clear on the key signal, and always include a recommended next step

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

As a Solutions Architect, Enterprise, you will be the technical lead for a portfolio of large customers evaluating, adopting and expanding Nebius AI Cloud. You will connect each customer's AI strategy and business priorities to a secure, scalable architecture, then guide the customer from technical discovery through technical scoping and production adoption.
This role sits at the intersection of cloud architecture, AI infrastructure and business value. You will work with Enterprise sales leaders and engage executives, platform teams, infrastructure leaders, security stakeholders and AI or machine learning practitioners. The strongest candidates combine hands-on technical depth with the judgment to navigate complex decisions of large organizations in real economic sectors.
You’re welcome to work remotely from the USA.

Lead technical discovery with business and technology stakeholders, clarify success criteria and translate requirements into practical AI cloud architectures.
Design solutions across Nebius product portfolio, with clear attention to Enterprise value proposition.
Plan and deliver architecture workshops, executive briefings, demonstrations, proofs of concept and technical enablement sessions.
Develop reference architectures, deployment patterns and infrastructure-as-code examples that help customers move from evaluation to production.
Build business cases with sales and customer stakeholders, navigating through complex decision-making processes in Enterprise.
Coordinate with Sales, Product, Engineering, Support and Customer Experience to resolve risks, define ownership and maintain momentum across complex engagements.
Represent the voice of Enterprise customers internally and provide specific feedback that improves product priorities.

Willingness to travel as customer and business needs require.

Reporting to the Directeur principal, PI et innovation SAP, with a delivery reporting line to the Vice President, Delivery for engagement work, the SAP BTP AI Solutions Architect defines the technical architecture of solutions built on SAP Business Technology Platform, including the artificial intelligence layer.
You design deliverable, secure, and operable solutions while accounting for consumption cost. You guide developers, address questions from client security and technology teams, and remain hands-on with code and delivery decisions.

Leadership, vision and initiative Own the architecture of SAP BTP and AI scope, set development standards, and review the work of BTP and AI orchestration developers.
Maintain the practice’s reference architectures, reusable patterns, and technical accelerators.
Technical and functional expertise Design subaccount and environment topology, Cloud Foundry versus Kyma runtime choices, HANA Cloud persistence, identity, authorization, and connectivity.
Architect SAP Business AI solutions using AI Core, AI Launchpad, generative AI hub, grounding, retrieval, and Joule extensibility.
Problem solving and analytical thinking Design SAP and non-SAP integration, including API management, eventing, monitoring, error handling, and supportable retry behaviour.
Resolve technical escalations during build, testing, cutover, and stabilization.
Consultative intelligence Estimate effort, complexity, environments, licensing, and consumption, then explain the financial implications of SAP BTP commercial models to stakeholders.
Knowledge sharing Mentor BTP and AI developers, lead internal enablement, and track capabilities SAP has actually released to guide client adoption.

Experience : At least ten (10) years in SAP or enterprise integration, including at least four (4) years building on SAP BTP.
BTP achievements : Delivery of at least three (3) production SAP BTP solutions, with the ability to explain lessons from operating them.
CAP and integration expertise : At least four (4) years with CAP in Node.js or Java and three (3) years with SAP Integration Suite, including API Management and Event Mesh.
AI and platform expertise : At least two (2) years with SAP Business AI, plus hands-on experience with Cloud Foundry, Kyma, HANA Cloud, XSUAA, IAS, IPS, role collections, and principal propagation.
Education : Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
Conditions : Canada-based remote role with client travel across North America representing approximately 20% to 30% of working time.
Communication : Good oral and written communication skills, in English, to communicate with clients located across North America.
Assets
ABAP Cloud, SAP Datasphere, Business Data Cloud, SAP Build Process Automation, Work Zone, CI/CD, CTMS, or gCTS.
SAP BTP Solution Architect, BTP Extensions with CAP, Integration Suite, SAP Business AI, or cloud architecture certification.
